preImplementationQuestions: Can the action arrive before React/session/router readiness?
Where is it retained and consumed once?
defects.detectionRule: Exercise cold onCreate/onNewIntent with React unavailable and prove bounded consume-once retention.
defects.runtimeSignature: ringing invite with no consumed action/token/media
defects.rollback: disable native action route and retain server-authoritative ringing/timeout
defects.prevention: private bounded native store plus native instrumentation

preImplementationQuestions: Which transaction wins accept versus timeout?
Is terminal history exactly once?
defects.detectionRule: Controlled barrier schedule for accept/timeout in both orders.
defects.runtimeSignature: accepted invite with ended room or duplicate terminal event
defects.rollback: fail closed to terminal server state
defects.prevention: atomic transition and locked invariant checks

preImplementationQuestions: What generation owns the thread active-room link?
defects.detectionRule: Pause old cleanup, create newer invite, then resume cleanup.
defects.runtimeSignature: new active room link becomes null or points to old room
defects.rollback: stop cleanup worker and repair from authoritative invite generation

preImplementationQuestions: Do all terminal paths end rooms, memberships, thread links, media, and history?
defects.detectionRule: Assert zero active/reconnecting memberships and exact terminal history after every terminal command.
defects.runtimeSignature: terminal invite with active room/membership/link
defects.rollback: emergency terminal cleanup using generation guard

preImplementationQuestions: Which exact EAS environment produced build and update config?
defects.detectionRule: Generate both configs with the exact environment and compare all release identity fields.
defects.runtimeSignature: build/update config differs only after EAS environment injection
defects.rollback: do not publish; select compatible prior update

preImplementationQuestions: What native capabilities does the bundle require and build provide?
defects.detectionRule: Required capabilities minus provided capabilities must be empty.
defects.runtimeSignature: JS calls an absent native module/API
defects.rollback: serve compatible rollback or embedded bundle

preImplementationQuestions: Is every required module compiled and registered in the target runtime?
defects.detectionRule: Inspect compiled module inventory and installed readback.
defects.runtimeSignature: Native module cannot be null
defects.rollback: load embedded safe bundle or prior compatible update

preImplementationQuestions: Is JSON encoded exactly once at every adapter boundary?
defects.detectionRule: Round-trip typed JSON through real RPC/Edge adapter and reject stringified JSON.
defects.runtimeSignature: JSONB value has string type containing escaped object
defects.rollback: disable writer and forward-correct affected rows

preImplementationQuestions: Are producer, storage, and evaluator scales identical?
defects.detectionRule: Boundary fixtures for min/max/threshold units across adapters.
defects.runtimeSignature: confidence/score is 100x expected
defects.rollback: stop evaluation/finalization

preImplementationQuestions: Can shared or sibling-platform evidence satisfy this claim?
defects.detectionRule: Reject evidence whose platform differs from the gate platform.
defects.runtimeSignature: iOS result finalized from Android/shared receipt
defects.rollback: revoke invalid outcome
defects.prevention: platform in primary keys and manifests

preImplementationQuestions: Are must-report and completion obligations satisfied for every VoIP push?
defects.detectionRule: Signed physical background/terminated delivery with CallKit and completion evidence.
defects.runtimeSignature: APNs accepted but no device PushKit callback
defects.rollback: stop VoIP delivery lane and preserve missed-call fallback
defects.prevention: native must-report contract and physical canary

preImplementationQuestions: Does evidence include PushKit callback, CallKit presentation, and physical action?
defects.detectionRule: Reject APNs response-only evidence.
defects.runtimeSignature: provider 200 with absent installed call
defects.rollback: retain gate as blocked external

preImplementationQuestions: Where are publication, subscription, and first-frame/audio measured?
defects.detectionRule: Require full token-to-first-media chain.
defects.runtimeSignature: Connected UI with no remote frames/audio
defects.rollback: end session and use authorized fallback

preImplementationQuestions: Does installed UI render the correct participant/track after first media?
defects.detectionRule: Bind first media telemetry to installed route and participant UI.
defects.runtimeSignature: track subscribed but UI remains preparing/blank
defects.rollback: show honest failure/fallback and end cleanly

preImplementationQuestions: Are source/target/store/product/environment identities exact?
defects.detectionRule: Reject target conflicts and prove atomic single-owner transfer.
defects.runtimeSignature: two active owners or wrong target entitlement
defects.rollback: revoke derived access and reconcile from verified provider event

preImplementationQuestions: What event time/version is authoritative for every type?
defects.detectionRule: Run renewal/expiration/refund/transfer in deterministic delayed orders.
defects.runtimeSignature: older event improperly restores or removes access
defects.rollback: reconcile from verified latest provider state

preImplementationQuestions: What exact implementation head/tree was reviewed?
defects.detectionRule: Compare review manifest head/tree/hash to current implementation.
defects.runtimeSignature: review body SHA differs from PR head
defects.rollback: invalidate review and rerun lanes

preImplementationQuestions: Is the review branch based on and descendant of the current implementation?
defects.detectionRule: Verify base/ancestry and review-files-only diff.
defects.runtimeSignature: review branch merge-base is an older implementation head
defects.rollback: create fresh review-only branch

preImplementationQuestions: Does Git contain every remote version/name/body exactly?
defects.detectionRule: Read-only remote statement comparison against Git.
defects.runtimeSignature: remote migration version absent from source
defects.rollback: block DB merge and add exact deployed source without reapply

preImplementationQuestions: Do version, name, statement count, and body hash all match?
defects.detectionRule: Compare exact four-part migration identity.
defects.runtimeSignature: same body under a different local version/name
defects.rollback: align Git filename to deployed identity without rewriting body

preImplementationQuestions: Can credentials appear in argv, environment dumps, ps output, or logs?
defects.detectionRule: Reject secret-bearing argv and scan evidence/log output.
defects.runtimeSignature: token-like value in command/process evidence
defects.rollback: stop process, rotate exposed credential, purge private evidence

preImplementationQuestions: Are serials, UDIDs, accounts, and private media excluded?
defects.detectionRule: Privacy scan committed evidence and require redacted summary.
defects.runtimeSignature: raw serial/UDID/account in Git diff
defects.rollback: remove from Git history under incident procedure

preImplementationQuestions: What timer, duration, stop condition, and owner authorize monitoring?
defects.detectionRule: Reject polling/sleep loops without bounded documented policy.
defects.runtimeSignature: repeated provider/device polls beyond 15 minutes
defects.rollback: stop process and record BLOCKED_EXTERNAL resumption

preImplementationQuestions: What exhaustive count, pairwise/3-way coverage, and mandatory goldens apply?
defects.detectionRule: Require deterministic covering-array report before manual execution.
defects.runtimeSignature: large manual matrix with unknown interaction coverage
defects.rollback: stop redundant execution and regenerate plan

preImplementationQuestions: Does one objective cover every touched high-risk domain without unrelated work?
defects.detectionRule: Map changed paths to domains and reject unrelated high-risk pairs.
defects.runtimeSignature: sentinel objective plus provider-money/native/database implementation
defects.rollback: split into bounded successor PRs
